title: Genesis USA - Electrified G80 / GV60 / GV70 page (NACS statement)
notes: Page (lists 2027 GV60, GV60 Magma, Electrified GV70): starting with 2026 models every Genesis EV has a NACS port; owners of 2023-2025 models with CCS ports need an external adapter; the NACS port gives access to more than 36,000 Tesla Superchargers. No G80 battery figures on the page.
